name: Linear
description: Issue tracking, cycle planning, project status, and developer workflows.

actions.name: Get Issue
actions.description: Fetches a Linear issue by identifier (e.g. CYC-123).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: GraphQL query string for fetching issue
parameters.default: query Issue($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { id identifier title description state { name } assignee { name } } }

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: GraphQL query variables including issue id or identifier

actions.name: Create Issue
actions.description: Creates a new issue in a Linear team.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: GraphQL mutation for creating an issue
parameters.default: mutation IssueCreate($input: IssueCreateInput!) { issueCreate(input: $input) { success issue { id identifier title url } } }

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Variables object with input: { teamId, title, description, priority }

actions.name: Update Issue
actions.description: Updates issue properties, status, state, or priority.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: GraphQL mutation for updating an issue
parameters.default: mutation IssueUpdate($id: String!, $input: IssueUpdateInput!) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success issue { id identifier state { name } } } }

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Variables with id and input updates

actions.name: Create Comment
actions.description: Posts a markdown comment on a Linear issue.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: GraphQL mutation for creating a comment
parameters.default: mutation CommentCreate($input: CommentCreateInput!) { commentCreate(input: $input) { success comment { id body } } }

actions.name: List Teams
actions.description: Lists workspace teams and their identifiers.

parameters.name: query
parameters.default: query { teams { nodes { id name key } } }
